scope: Cross-camera AF foundations for future changes. No current lens-specific patch, physical motor operation or EEPROM write.

camera_contracts.capability: bit 6 of communication object C+5272 selects InMotor versus Joint. This is not an established SDM-only flag or a lens compatibility guarantee.
camera_contracts.producer: Response byte 6 via 0x52f18638 updates the field on mode 3 or mode 0/submode 3. Command 0x8205/type 2 copies cache byte 0 after exchange returns 0. Both update the same field; distinct inputs are not assumed equal.
camera_contracts.request: The 0x8900 builder at 0x52efc7a0 masks value to 14 bits and places a nonzero direction flag in bit 15, then emits two big-endian payload bytes. Queue entry and physical frame are separate boundaries.
camera_contracts.validation_scope: Original selected ARM functions/fragments with synthetic replies and explicit allocator, queue, transport, event and wait substitutes; repeated from both RTOS and decoded-image carriers.

camera_contracts.address_domain: Decoded file offsets unless explicitly labeled VA
camera_contracts.capability: Command 0x8205 stores a one-byte response at lens object+6 on accepted transport status 0. Predicate 0x4c500 tests bit 6 before lens command versus body-driver preparation.
camera_contracts.request: A separate producer/consumer path transforms pulse bookkeeping into drive requests; its thresholds and signed low-16-bit behavior are version-specific. Lens calculation query 0x8211 reads a two-byte big-endian response.
camera_contracts.validation_scope: Original ARM acquisition 8, body control 14 and lens control 3 cases, plus prior drive selection cases. In the 25 control cases, prepared objects and memory values supply fixture inputs; the sole execution replacement is the 0x93f94 lens-transfer hook.
unresolved: actual motion and optical focus completion

camera_contracts.capability: Discovery maps supported groups/operations. The AF-enable getter requires communication bit 3 and group 2 operation 4. The separate search transport gate checks the operation map only when map-read-OK equals 1 and does not repeat the communication-bit test. Extended specification query depends on group 8 operation 7.
camera_contracts.request: Search, stop and location drive use distinct messages 6, 8 and 7. Mode 3 defers search to VD synchronization. Position and speed limits are distinct from actuator inhibition.
camera_contracts.acknowledgement: Mode-2 setter returns the worker's status after pending clears; synthetic acknowledgement at wait 101 is late. This counter is not a measured duration or physical motion result.
camera_contracts.completion: A separate live-view callback consumes synthetic motion telemetry. State 1 can advance by motion, a poll count or a bypass byte; state 2 emits completion on motion==0. Another request branch can notify immediately.
camera_contracts.validation_scope: Original MIPS/VEX discovery, cached data, speed, acknowledgement and completion with synthetic lens replies/scheduler/telemetry. Optional Unicorn was unavailable and not used.

interpretation_rules: Similar field bits or command numbers across models do not establish a shared ABI.
A capability override cannot establish absent mechanical coupling or compatible optics.
Queue acceptance, transport response, motion stop and optical focus are different observations.
Retain lens limits, direction, cancellation, stale response and timeout behavior when later replacing an estimator.
The official older smc DA-star 16-50 SDM is an example of both SDM and body-motor support, not proof that every SDM lens supports both.
Ricoh's Q7 table lists its official K-mount adapter as manual-focus-only; a body-drive policy from K-3 cameras cannot be assumed applicable.
